q_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He apologised _____ being late to the meeting.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He apologised _____ being late to the meeting.
solution:
The verb 'apologise' is followed by the preposition 'for' when the speaker is stating the reason for the apology. For example: 'He apologised for his behavior.' In this sentence, 'being late' is the reason, so 'for' is the correct choice.

📌 Concept: जब हम किसी कारण (Reason) के लिए क्षमा माँगते हैं, तो 'Apologise' के साथ 'for' का प्रयोग किया जाता है। 🧠 Explanation: यहाँ 'being late' (देरी से आना) कारण है, इसलिए 'for' का प्रयोग सही है। अगर हम किसी व्यक्ति से क्षमा माँगते, तो 'to' का प्रयोग होता (e.g., Apologise to the boss).

Short Trick: Apologise + to (person) | Apologise + for (reason).

q_en:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

In Magadh, there was a system of government run by a single person.6685
q_hi:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

In Magadh, there was a system of government run by a single person.6685
solution:
Monarchy is a form of government where a single person (a monarch, like a king or queen) holds supreme authority. Autocracy also refers to rule by one person with absolute power, but in historical contexts like Magadh, 'Monarchy' is the most precise term for kingship.

🔍 Word Insight: - Monarchy: राजतंत्र (शासन एक राजा/रानी द्वारा)। - Democracy: लोकतंत्र (जनता का शासन)। - Autocracy: निरंकुश शासन (एक व्यक्ति की असीमित शक्ति)। - Plutocracy: धनिकतंत्र (अमीरों का शासन)। 🧠 Explanation: मगध एक साम्राज्य था जहाँ राजा का शासन था, इसलिए 'Monarchy' सही विकल्प है।

Short Trick: Mono (Single) + Archy (Rule) = Monarchy.

Code of diplomatic etiquette and precedence
q_hi:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Code of diplomatic etiquette and precedence
solution:
Protocol refers to the official procedure or system of rules governing affairs of state or diplomatic occasions. It includes the correct conduct and etiquette observed by diplomats and heads of state.

📌 Concept: राजनयिक शिष्टाचार (Diplomatic etiquette) के नियमों को 'Protocol' कहा जाता है। 🔍 Word Insight: - Protocol: आधिकारिक शिष्टाचार। - Convention: सम्मेलन या पारंपरिक रीति-रिवाज। - Treaty: दो देशों के बीच संधि। - Sanction: प्रतिबंध या अनुमति।

Short Trick: Diplomatic rules = Protocol.

q_hi:

The _______ sky and clouds made for a beautiful evening.
solution:
'Blue' is the most standard adjective to describe the sky's color in this context. While 'setting' could describe a sun, the phrase 'blue sky' is a common descriptive pair that fits the descriptive nature of the sentence.

🧠 Explanation: आकाश (sky) की विशेषता बताने के लिए 'blue' (नीला) सबसे उपयुक्त विशेषण है। 'Risen' और 'Arise' क्रिया के रूप हैं, जो यहाँ फिट नहीं बैठते।

Short Trick: Standard color for sky = Blue.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.

We had a _________ dinner at the newly opened restaurant.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.

We had a _________ dinner at the newly opened restaurant.
solution:
'Delightful' is the adjective form of the word 'delight', which is required to modify the noun 'dinner'. It means causing great pleasure. 'Delighted' is an adjective used to describe a person's feeling, not an object like a dinner.

📌 Concept: किसी वस्तु (Dinner) की विशेषता बताने के लिए adjective चाहिए। 🧠 Explanation: - Delightful: सुखद/शानदार (वस्तु के लिए)। - Delighted: खुश (व्यक्ति के लिए)। यहाँ डिनर की बात हो रही है, इसलिए 'Delightful' सही है।

Short Trick: Object/Thing + -ful | Person + -ed.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He looked at her __________, realising something was wrong.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He looked at her __________, realising something was wrong.
solution:
The second part of the sentence, 'realising something was wrong', suggests a serious or cautious mood. 'Slowly' fits best as it conveys a careful or gradual observation. The other options (happily, excitedly, joyfully) represent positive emotions that contradict the realization of trouble.

🧠 Explanation: वाक्य का दूसरा हिस्सा कहता है 'realising something was wrong' (यह महसूस करते हुए कि कुछ गलत था)। यह एक गंभीर स्थिति है। 'Happily' या 'Joyfully' जैसे शब्द यहाँ गलत होंगे। 'Slowly' (धीरे से/ध्यान से) स्थिति की गंभीरता को दर्शाता है।

Short Trick: Check context: 'Something wrong' = Negative/Serious mood.

q_en:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. and we enjoyed a picnic
B. although it was raining,
C. we went to the park,
D. under the shelter7562
q_hi:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. and we enjoyed a picnic
B. although it was raining,
C. we went to the park,
D. under the shelter7562
solution:
The logical sequence is: (B) Although it was raining, (C) we went to the park, (A) and we enjoyed a picnic (D) under the shelter. This structure sets a condition (rain), an action (went to park), and a result (enjoyed picnic) with a location (under shelter).

🧠 Explanation: सही क्रम 'BCAD' है। वाक्य: Although it was raining (B), we went to the park (C), and we enjoyed a picnic (A) under the shelter (D). अर्थ: हालाँकि बारिश हो रही थी, हम पार्क गए और शेल्टर के नीचे पिकनिक का आनंद लिया।

Short Trick: Contrast word (Although) starts the context.

q_en:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(O) noisy colonies, where they are
(P) constantly bombarded by stimulation
(Q) produced by coresidents
(R) penguins sleep in large,
(S) from movement and sounds
q_hi:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(O) noisy colonies, where they are
(P) constantly bombarded by stimulation
(Q) produced by coresidents
(R) penguins sleep in large,
(S) from movement and sounds
solution:
The correct order is ROPSQ: 'Penguins sleep in large (R) noisy colonies, where they are (O) constantly bombarded by stimulation (P) from movement and sounds (S) produced by coresidents (Q).' This sequence correctly identifies the subjects, their environment, and the cause of stimulation.

🧠 Explanation: सही क्रम 'ROPSQ' है। 1. 'Penguins sleep in large' (R) से शुरुआत होगी। 2. इसके बाद 'noisy colonies' (O) आएगा क्योंकि यह 'large' के साथ फिट बैठता है। 3. फिर उनकी स्थिति: 'constantly bombarded by stimulation' (P)। 4. अंत में उत्तेजना का स्रोत: 'from movement and sounds' (S) 'produced by coresidents' (Q)।

Short Trick: Adjective 'large' must be followed by its noun context (colonies).

q_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

____ moon looked beautiful as it rose above ____ mountains in ____ evening.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

____ moon looked beautiful as it rose above ____ mountains in ____ evening.
solution:
1. 'The moon' is used because the Moon is a unique celestial body. 2. 'The mountains' is used to refer to a specific group of mountains mentioned in the context. 3. 'The evening' is used because parts of the day (morning, afternoon, evening) take the definite article 'the'.

📌 Concept: - Unique objects: 'The' moon. - Specific location: 'The' mountains. - Time of day: 'The' evening. 🧠 Explanation: तीनों ही मामलों में निश्चित (Definite) वस्तुओं या समय की बात हो रही है, इसलिए तीनों रिक्त स्थानों में 'the' का प्रयोग होगा।

Short Trick: Unique objects and parts of the day always take 'The'.

solution:

🔍 Word Insight: - Compact: सघन/पास-पास (सटा हुआ)। - Scattered: बिखरा हुआ (विलोम)। - Dense/Packed: सघन (पर्यायवाची)।

Short Trick: Compact = Tight space | Scattered = Spread out.

🔍 Word Insight: - Traditional: पारंपरिक/प्रचलित। - Conventional: परंपरागत (पर्यायवाची)। - Antique: प्राचीन वस्तु। - Modern: आधुनिक (विलोम)।

Short Trick: Traditional = Following long-standing customs = Conventional.
